criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: All nine frames are rendered places. The declared golden hour reads as a flat cool grey with banding on 1, 2, 4, 5, 6 and 7, frame 7 reads as a diagram, frame 6's berm is a sprite hill with a clipped branch, frame 8 is fogged with halos behind the furniture (9 too), frame 5's figure is a mannequin on untextured clay. More than one frame leans on a default, so below 7.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one hero changing state on every frame, both continuity devices work, no value strobe. Frames 7 and 8 sit outside, and 1 to 8 read overcast where 9 alone is sunlit.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces. Looser than the sources: slide 4's linear dBA bars against a computed 100 times power ratio; the petition outcome and appeal motion rest on journalism; 'accessory buildings' for c31's 'accessory structures'; 'stays out' in the present tense for a proposed term; slide 3's hall without its drawn-for-scale disclosure; first_comment omits c3 and c10 used in the caption. None is a hard fail.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and the deadline are named, the stakes concrete. The next step is only implied.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns a swipe, 2 pays, 8 is a real counterweight, 9 closes on the date. Distances restated on 3, 5 and 6, and 7 arrives without a bridge.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Specific and on register. The meeting line is boilerplate and repeated, and the caption's 'it' points at the 85 dBA.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: A new instrument and clean dedupe. The carried hero repeats nos. 39 to 43, golden hour repeats no. 40, the third data center deck in the window.

one_sentence_fix: Re-light the world to the declared golden hour with no banding and long east casts, and rebuild frame 7's basin as a modelled place.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat sine-ripple plane, a flat near bank band, a thin field strip, a mannequin on the far bank.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Camera at the near lip with the modelled bank in the lower third, a noise normal reflecting the warm band, remove the figure.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A sprite hill, a clipped cedar branch, a banded grey sky, no raking light.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Crouch at the toe so the crest runs diagonal against the low sun, light the crest, delete the clipped tree.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Fog with no sky, flat squares, halos behind the furniture.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Cut the fog so a sky returns, long east shadows, seat the kicker on clean sky.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Untextured clay, a mannequin, a banded grey sky.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rake the low sun across the clay, turn the person and rim-light the shoulders, warm the sky.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A thick black post, a flat ribbon, a dull grey sun, the stake behind the hook.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A rim highlight on the lath, cloth shading on the flagging, move the stake right of the hook.
